title: narcissus hispanicus subsp. provincialis
intro: Narcissus hispanicus subsp. provincialis, commonly known as Provençal daffodil or Narcissus provincialis, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the Amaryllidaceae family. It is a perennial bulbous plant native to southern France and northwestern Spain, characterized by its bright yellow trumpet-shaped flowers. The Provençal daffodil is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional folk medicine, where it is used to treat various health conditions. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, such as galantamine and lycorine, that have been shown to possess anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, as well as potential benefits in treating conditions such as anxiety, insomnia, and Alzheimer's disease.
